notes: GROUND-LEVEL CLUTTER, and the cheapest asset in the library on purpose. Its whole job is to break up the smooth terrain plane you see BETWEEN the tufts at close range: the structure gate measured grass-close's near band at 0.0033 median tile detail against refs/genshin/grasslands.jpg's 0.058, an eight-to-twentyfold shortfall, while the same meadow at eye 6 already passes ABOVE the reference. So the deficit is specifically the last couple of metres. Three blades rather than fourteen, and a third of the height, because it is filling gaps rather than reading as a clump — at this size it is a value break on the ground, not a silhouette. Placed by the near band's own finer second lattice in src/world/grass.ts, so it inherits the wind field and the deform crush for free and costs no new material or draw call beyond its own batch. NOT a texture: the brief abandoned the painterly overlay because it read as mottled camouflage, and the reference's close-range detail is discrete objects anyway - individual sprigs, litter and small stones, not noise.

rules.placement: Close-range clutter between tufts to break the bare terrain plane in the last couple of metres; near band only.
rules.avoid: Avoid desert and alpine; near-band grass biomes only.
